package v1

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
)

// NewRouter registers student-facing routes.
func NewRouter(
	answerHandler *handlers.AnswerHandler,
	positionHandler *handlers.StudentPositionHandler,
	studentPracticeTaskHandler *handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler,
	runtimeHandler *handlers.StudentRuntimeHandler,
	onboardingHandler *handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler,
	courseAssignmentHandler *handlers.StudentCourseAssignmentHandler,
	legacyPracticeWritesEnabled bool,
	journeyHandlers ...*handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler,
) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Use(middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO"))
	r.Post("/student/tasks/{taskID}/start", answerHandler.StartTask)
	r.Post("/student/tasks/{taskID}/submit", answerHandler.SubmitTask)
	r.Post("/student/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/submit", answerHandler.SubmitAnswerById)
	r.Get("/student/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}", answerHandler.GetAnswerById)
	r.Get("/student/tasks/{taskID}/access", answerHandler.GetTaskAccess)
	r.Get("/student/tasks/{taskID}", answerHandler.GetTask)
	r.Get("/student/lessons/{lessonID}", answerHandler.GetLesson)
	r.Get("/student/lessons/{lessonID}/access", answerHandler.GetLessonAccess)
	r.Get("/student/tasks/{taskID}/answers", answerHandler.ListMyAnswers)
	r.Get("/student/courses/{courseID}/progression", answerHandler.GetCourseProgression)
	r.Get("/student/course-versions/{courseID}/progression", answerHandler.GetCourseProgression)
	r.Get("/student/answers/{answerID}", answerHandler.GetMyAnswer)
	r.Get("/student/results", answerHandler.ListMyResults)
	r.Get("/student/results/{answerID}", answerHandler.GetMyResult)
	if positionHandler != nil {
		r.Get("/student/positions", positionHandler.ListStudentPositions)
		r.Put("/student/positions", positionHandler.UpdateStudentPositions)
	}
	if onboardingHandler != nil {
		r.Get("/student/onboarding", onboardingHandler.GetProfile)
		r.Put("/student/onboarding", onboardingHandler.PutProfile)
		r.Get("/student/onboarding/draft", onboardingHandler.GetDraftProfile)
		r.Put("/student/onboarding/draft", onboardingHandler.PutDraftProfile)
		r.Post("/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", onboardingHandler.FinalizeDraftProfile)
	}
	if courseAssignmentHandler != nil {
		r.Get("/student/courses", courseAssignmentHandler.List)
		r.Get("/student/courses/{courseID}", courseAssignmentHandler.Get)
	}
	if len(journeyHandlers) > 0 && journeyHandlers[0] != nil {
		journey := journeyHandlers[0]
		r.Get("/student/next-action", journey.GetNextAction)
		r.Get("/student/learning-path-items/{itemID}/content", journey.GetLessonItemContent)
		r.Post("/student/learning-path-items/{itemID}/theory-acknowledgements", journey.AcknowledgeLessonTheory)
		r.Get("/student/learning-path", journey.GetLearningPath)
		r.Get("/student/learning-paths", journey.ListLearningPaths)
		r.Get("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}", journey.GetLearningPathByID)
		r.Get("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context", journey.GetAssignedLessonContext)
		r.Post("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/activate", journey.ActivateLearningPath)
		r.Post("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/pause", journey.PauseLearningPath)
		r.Post("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/resume", journey.ResumeLearningPath)
		r.Get("/student/learning-context", journey.GetLearningContext)
		r.Get("/student/diagnostics/latest", journey.GetLatestDiagnostic)
		r.Post("/student/learning-sessions", journey.StartLearningSession)
		r.Get("/student/learning-sessions", journey.ListLearningSessions)
		r.Get("/student/learning-sessions/{sessionID}", journey.GetLearningSession)
		r.Put("/student/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/end", journey.EndLearningSession)
	}
	if studentPracticeTaskHandler != nil {
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks", studentPracticeTaskHandler.ListStudentPracticeTasks)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetStudentPracticeTask)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts", studentPracticeTaskHandler.ListStudentPracticeTaskParts)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetStudentPracticeTaskPart)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskLesson)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/access", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskLessonAccess)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskTask)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/access", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskTaskAccess)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/roadmap", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetStudentPracticeTaskRoadmap)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews", studentPracticeTaskHandler.ListPracticeTaskFinalReviews)
		r.Get("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/publication", studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner)
		if legacyPracticeWritesEnabled {
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks", studentPracticeTaskHandler.CreateStudentPracticeTask)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/start", studentPracticeTaskHandler.StartPracticeTaskTask)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/submit", studentPracticeTaskHandler.SubmitPracticeTaskTask)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/submit", studentPracticeTaskHandler.SubmitPracticeTaskAnswerById)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/open", studentPracticeTaskHandler.OpenPracticeTaskPart)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/validate", studentPracticeTaskHandler.ValidatePracticeTaskPart)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/recalculate", studentPracticeTaskHandler.Recalculate)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews", studentPracticeTaskHandler.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview)
			r.Put("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/publication", studentPracticeTaskHandler.SetPracticeTaskPublication)
		} else {
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/start", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/submit", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/milestones/{milestoneID}/lessons/{lessonID}/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/submit", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/open", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/parts/{partID}/validate", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/recalculate", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Post("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
			r.Put("/student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/publication", retiredLegacyPracticeWrite)
		}
	}
	if runtimeHandler != nil {
		r.Get("/runtime/tasks/{taskID}", runtimeHandler.GetRuntimeTask)
		r.Get("/runtime/tasks/{taskID}/access", runtimeHandler.GetRuntimeTaskAccess)
		r.Get("/runtime/lessons/{lessonID}", runtimeHandler.GetRuntimeLesson)
	}
	return r
}

// RegisterDiagnosticAssessmentRoutes is kept separate from the historic
// constructor signature so existing callers cannot accidentally expose it.
func RegisterDiagnosticAssessmentRoutes(r chi.Router, handler *handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) {
	if handler == nil {
		return
	}
	// This literal must precede {attemptID}; Chi otherwise treats "current" as
	// an attempt id and the resume locator becomes unreachable.
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/current", handler.GetCurrent)
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}", handler.Get)
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}", handler.GetTask)
	r.Post("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}/submit", handler.Submit)
	r.Post("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/complete", handler.Complete)
}

func retiredLegacyPracticeWrite(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusGone)
	_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"error":"legacy_practice_runtime_retired","owner":"ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator"}`))
}
